datasets.name: The Way to Yahuweh downloadable manuscript and research documents
datasets.language: Hebrew, Aramaic, Koine Greek, and related languages as represented by individual files
datasets.coverage: Selected Dead Sea Scrolls transcriptions, ancient papyrus transcriptions, Septuagint manuscript transcriptions, and research documents
datasets.record_type: third-party transcription and research-document collection; each file must be catalogued individually
datasets.license: The site's About page states that all downloadable documents are released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve attribution, license notices, and share-alike terms for adapted material.

source_policy.attribution: The Way to Yahuweh; identify the individual document and its cited underlying edition or manuscript source.
source_policy.handling: Use as an additional transcription or comparison source, not as an automatic substitute for institutional manuscript images or critical editions.
required_metadata: underlying edition and page/plate references where supplied
limitations: The downloadable documents are editorial transcriptions or research documents, not photographic facsimiles.
A file's manuscript label does not by itself establish that every displayed reading is independently verified against the original manuscript.
Separate manuscript witnesses and comparison texts must remain distinguished.
The site owner's editorial interpretations must not be presented as institutional consensus or as the manuscript's unmediated wording.

datasets.name: Swete Septuagint — Greek Apocrypha and Deuterocanonical Writings
datasets.record_type: digitized Greek edition text with per-verse references; not diplomatic manuscript transcription
datasets.edition: Henry Barclay Swete, The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint; digital text from Open Greek and Latin First1KGreek
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the First1KGreek digital transcription; preserve attribution and share-alike terms
datasets.attribution: Henry Barclay Swete, ed.; Open Greek and Latin First1KGreek digital transcription distributed by nathans/lxx-swete
limitations: Swete is an edited Septuagint text and must not be described as the unmediated reading of one ancient codex.
Old Greek and Theodotionic forms of Daniel, Susanna, and Bel and the Dragon are stored separately.
The Greek text does not replace Hebrew or Aramaic witnesses, including Dead Sea Scroll fragments.
The Greek Swete source does not contain 2 Esdras / 4 Ezra; the current complete 16-chapter import is a Latin transmission text, not a Greek manuscript witness.
Odes is a collection of scriptural canticles; its internal numbering is retained and individual compositions must not be silently treated as separate books.
Psalm 151 is separately indexed from the Greek Psalter only when explicitly present in the source file.
The Prayer of Manasseh is separately indexed from Odes 8 while retaining its source reference; the full Daniel text retains the other Greek additions.

datasets.name: Latin Library Apocrypha texts collected by CLTK
coverage: 2 Esdras / 4 Ezra (16 chapters; composite 5 Ezra, 4 Ezra, and 6 Ezra)
datasets.record_type: public-domain digital Latin text; not a diplomatic manuscript transcription
datasets.edition: Latin Library source files collected in cltk/lat_text_latin_library
datasets.license: Public Domain as stated by the Latin Library source; repository README directs users to its public-domain notice
datasets.attribution: The Latin Library; collected in the Classical Language Toolkit (CLTK)
limitations: The supplied Latin is a transmission text, not the lost Greek or hypothesized Semitic original of 4 Ezra.
2 Esdras is a composite collection: 5 Ezra (chapters 1–2), 4 Ezra proper (chapters 3–14), and 6 Ezra (chapters 15–16).
The digital source does not identify a modern critical edition; compare with Bensly/James and other manuscript editions before making manuscript-level claims.
The Prayer of Manasseh is preserved in multiple traditions; this Latin text is one transmitted form and is not presented as the original language.

datasets.name: Qumran-Digital: Text und Lexikon — manuscript transcription collection
datasets.coverage: The project's current transcription index lists more than one thousand manuscript transcription pages, including 1QS, 1QpHab, 1QM, 1QHᵃ and numerous biblical and non-biblical Qumran manuscripts.
datasets.record_type: manuscript-based digital transcriptions with fragment/line layout and separately displayed textual parallels
datasets.edition: Qumran-Digital project; based on earlier Qumran-Wörterbuch and Martin Abegg precursor transcriptions, with subsequent editorial and palaeographic revisions
datasets.attribution: DFG-Projekt 465277421, Qumran-Digital: Text und Lexikon; based on earlier Qumran-Wörterbuch project and precursor text by Martin Abegg.
datasets.status: source index verified; additional individual manuscript transcriptions require passage/line-level import and validation before being marked available offline
limitations: A transcription index entry is not itself an imported transcription in this app.
The project's main text, manuscript parallels and biblical comparison texts must remain separate witnesses.
Preserve brackets, uncertain letters, corrections, lacunae, editorial signs, manuscript identifiers and displayed line labels.
Do not convert digital display-line labels into physical column/line coordinates unless the source explicitly establishes that equivalence.
CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and share-alike terms must accompany imported and adapted text.

datasets.name: Codex Sinaiticus electronic transcription (ITSEE v1.95)
datasets.coverage: Surviving manuscript pages represented in the pinned upstream XML; exact page, column, and line counts are generated in sinaiticus/sinaiticus_index.json during the build.
datasets.record_type: diplomatic manuscript transcription with original page, column, line, and word identifiers
datasets.edition: Codex Sinaiticus Project electronic transcription; ITSEE repository v1.95, pinned upstream commit af1633b5102cbe6200e79053cc618ac447e1bb16
datasets.attribution: Codex Sinaiticus Project; XML maintained by ITSEE, University of Birmingham.
datasets.status: Imported at APK build time as offline page-specific compressed line records; page/column/line coverage is generated in the index.
limitations: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0: non-commercial use only; adaptations must be shared under the same licence.
The transcription is not a photographic facsimile; manuscript images remain at institutional source websites.
Original page, column, line, and word identifiers are preserved; the import does not invent chapter-and-verse references.
Text is displayed as supplied by the source XML and is not silently normalized.

datasets.name: ETCBC/CACCHT Dead Sea Scrolls diplomatic transcriptions (Martin Abegg data)
datasets.coverage: Imported line-level text from the biblical and non-biblical scroll datasets; exact scroll/fragment/line coverage is generated in dss/etcbc_scroll_index.json during the build.
datasets.record_type: diplomatic manuscript transcription dataset with normalized token stream and separately retained textual parallels
datasets.edition: Martin G. Abegg Jr. transcriptions, distributed through ETCBC/CACCHT and the Qumran Digital Reader structured export; pinned upstream revision f54f38464e18409eed8286fe24dd24f88d4735dd
datasets.attribution: Martin G. Abegg Jr.; ETCBC/CACCHT Dead Sea Scrolls corpus; structured export by Qumran Digital Reader (QDR). See https://github.com/ETCBC/dss and https://github.com/evenderekh/QDR.
datasets.status: Imported at build time as offline line-level text; coverage and counts validated in the generated scroll index.
limitations: CC BY-NC 4.0: no commercial use or commercial redistribution without separate permission from the rights holder.
The underlying transcriptions are Abegg-derived and must not be described as fresh independent readings of every manuscript image.
The first diplomatic display form is retained separately from the normalized token stream; brackets, lacuna indicators and editorial signs are not silently removed.
Textual parallel references are retained as separate metadata and are not merged into the manuscript's own transcription.
The corpus is not a photographic facsimile; manuscript images and their reproduction rights are separate.
The QDR structured export includes word-level lexical and morphological source data, but this app import focuses on line-level text and coordinates.

datasets.name: Codex Vaticanus (GA 03) New Testament transcription
datasets.coverage: Original surviving New Testament manuscript transcription supplied by NTVMR document 20003; exact page and record coverage is generated in vaticanus/vaticanus_index.json during the build.
datasets.record_type: source TEI manuscript transcription with original-hand readings and correction notes, indexed by manuscript page
datasets.edition: Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room, Codex Vaticanus (GA 03; Vat.gr.1209)
datasets.attribution: Codex Vaticanus (GA 03), New Testament transcription by the Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room, CC BY 4.0.
datasets.status: Imported during APK build as offline page-indexed records; page, column, line and source labels are retained where present.
limitations: The transcription is an electronic scholarly transcription, not a photographic facsimile.
The original codex does not preserve the Pastoral Letters, Philemon, or Revelation; the surviving Hebrews text ends at 9:14.
The Revelation now bound with the codex is a later fifteenth-century supplement and is excluded.
Original-hand readings are displayed where the TEI distinguishes corrections; correction readings are retained as notes.
Missing manuscript portions are not supplied from another edition or witness.

datasets.name: Papyrus 46 (GA P46) — INTF NTVMR diplomatic transcription
datasets.coverage: Surviving page-level transcription of Papyrus 46, document 10046. Exact page and record counts are generated in papyri/p46/p46_index.json during the build.
datasets.record_type: TEI diplomatic manuscript transcription, indexed by original NTVMR page identifier
datasets.edition: Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room, GA P46
datasets.attribution: Papyrus 46 (GA P46), transcription and catalogue data by the Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room, CC BY 4.0.
datasets.status: Imported at APK build time as offline compressed page records.
limitations: P46 is a fragmentary codex; the transcription contains only surviving manuscript material.
The codex originally comprised approximately 104 leaves; 86 leaves survive.
Lost opening and ending portions are not supplied.
Supplied readings are bracketed only where the source encodes them; no missing text is reconstructed.
The electronic transcription is not a photographic facsimile.

datasets.name: Papyrus 52 (GA P52) — INTF NTVMR diplomatic transcription
datasets.coverage: Single surviving fragment of P52, preserving portions of John 18:31–33 and 18:37–38; exact page and record counts are generated in papyri/p52/p52_index.json during the build.
datasets.record_type: TEI diplomatic manuscript transcription, indexed by original NTVMR page identifier
datasets.edition: Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room, GA P52
datasets.attribution: Papyrus 52 (GA P52), transcription and catalogue data by the Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room, CC BY 4.0.
datasets.status: Imported at APK build time as offline compressed page records.
limitations: Only one small fragment survives; the transcription contains only source text for the extant fragment.
The commonly cited second-century dating is palaeographical and debated; it is not an exact date.
The manuscript is not proof of a definitive earliest surviving New Testament manuscript.
Supplied readings are bracketed only where encoded by the source; missing portions are not reconstructed.
The electronic transcription is not a photographic facsimile.
